text_block_list.name: Fine and the Others
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so very much for coming♪ Thank 
you very much! Thaaanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"We delivered the planned amount without a 
hitch, so there's only one thing left to 
do! A congratulatory toast!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: With ramen broth!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: With ramen broth?!

The 1st Annual 'Ramen Jamboree' was a huge 
success! The fans who visited the 
racetrack were all smiling brightly at how 
delicious the ramen was.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
However, I won't settle for just this! 
Because what we did today helped me see 
areas to improve.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Right! Messed-up orders, missing drinks... 
There are still so many areas where I fell 
short!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... So n-next time, I'll pay closer 
attention to even the smallest details...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I will make this a flawless 'Ramen 
Jamboree.' Crane your necks—no, keep the 
straightaways short and wait for me, dear 
fans!
choice_data_list:
...They really care about their fans, 
don't they?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Great work today, everyone! We pulled off 
the ramen event without a hitch!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. But it was total chaos. Mostly on 
my end. I kept serving rock-hard noodles. 
And Doto too. She was constantly spilling 
broth.”

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I'm so sorryyyy...! N-Next time! I 
promise I'll do better next time!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No... if we're talking about pure chaos, I 
think pretty much everyone was going 
through it to some degree!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right. It definitely felt 
more like I just barely managed to finish.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So next time! Let's make something that 
will truly satisfy all our fans!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"The 'repaying of gratitude' we're aiming 
for only truly counts if we can accomplish 
that!"
choice_data_list:
...They really care about their fans, 
don't they?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ Indeed~. They're all such good, 
hardworking girls.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
So let's keep doing our best to support 
them too!
choice_data_list: Yes! I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.text:
A few days later. Late in the evening, I 
spotted Ms. Tazuna heading somewhere.
choice_data_list: What's wrong? Is there a problem?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! There's definitely a problem! And 
what's more, this has been going on for a 
whole week...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how about you too, Trainer? Let's go 
warn them together!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
One-two-three! One-two-three! ...Yeah, I 
think I'm getting the hang of it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Fine-chan! To achieve all 
this with five hours of training every 
day...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ With this, we can speed up our 
service. And bring smiles to even more 
customers!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Right! ...Alright, me too! Next time, I'll 
make sure it's an event without a single 
regret!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, now. At this time of night— 
No-no, you two!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone here is taking on this ramen 
event on top of keeping up with regular 
classes and race training.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In other words, what is required is 
stricter condition management. And by 
extension, securing adequate rest.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
However, ever since the Ramen Jamboree... 
haven't you been pushing yourself a bit 
too hard?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... You're right. Just because it was 
necessary, I might've rushed things a 
little too much.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad you understand! And with that! 
Let's wrap things up for today—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Wanna go get something to eat? Like 
ramen!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! It's delicious! The noodles are so 
smooth! And the broth is so rich! It has a 
really sharp flavor kick at the finish, 
you could say!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
To think Tokyo still had a place like 
this...! Ramen truly knows no bounds!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ It's also delicious if you order it 
as a set with rice, you know? You should 
definitely try it!
choice_data_list:
Whoa, what should I do!? Should I add some 
more?!

Whoa, what should I do! Should I add a 
little more?

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the meal!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, Tazuna-san! Getting 
some food in me let me catch my breath!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Doing the event gave me a lot to think 
about... so I might've pushed myself a 
little too hard.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
No, as long as you're aware of it, that's 
fine! Please continue taking good care of 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking about doing things 'for the 
fans' is important. However—"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"If you end up collapsing from that, it 
won't do any good for your fans."

Suddenly, a feeling struck my heart. Why 
do Ms. Tazuna's words carry so much weight 
when she speaks about the fans...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"I just wanted to tell you. The greatest 
way an Umamusume can repay someone is—"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To keep running, in good health. ...That's 
truly all that matters.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Your spirit is admirable, and that's why I 
will spare no support! But... please, 
never forget that one thing.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Giving love back to your fans is 
important, but... so is loving yourself, 
who is so dearly loved by everyone."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Please, take good care of it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ms. Tazuna...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, just as you said, Ms. Tazuna. I 
won't forget the advice you gave me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait! Is that why Ms. Tazuna helped us 
out this time?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Were you keeping watch over us to keep us 
in check in case we pushed ourselves too 
hard?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
No! Keep watch? Never! I trust all of you 
completely!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Um... then why? Why are you being so 
dedicated to me...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I was so moved by everyone's feelings that 
I wanted to ease your burden, if even just 
a little—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Ufufu♪ That's part of the reason, sure. 
But in the end, I'm just like everyone 
else!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Just like us?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I love ramen too, after all!
